5. After-Sales Support: Even after the purchase, the seller continued to provide assistance and support. They answered all my questions promptly and addressed any concerns I had. This level of customer service was highly appreciated.

6. Reliability: After driving the car for a few weeks, I can confidently say that it has been very reliable. I have not encountered any major issues, and it has been performing exceptionally well. This further validates my satisfaction with the purchase.

In conclusion, my experience of purchasing a used car was extremely positive. The car's excellent condition, transparent documentation, fair price negotiation, and after-sales support all contributed to my satisfaction. I would highly recommend this seller (Mr.Abul)to anyone in the market for a used car.
